```plato

    //==
    // # Vector2D — planar perp and signed area (2D cross-product analog)
    //
    // 2D has no cross product; the honest planar primitives are the perpendicular
    // and the scalar (z-component) cross. Naming them here keeps 2D code from
    // faking a 3D cross.

    // The left perpendicular of v: v rotated +90 degrees (CCW), (-Y, X). Same
    // length as v; the right perpendicular is its negation.
    Perp(v: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => (-v.Y, v.X);
```
